span.p:
Admission control: Azure Policy add-on (Gatekeeper managed by AKS, assigned per environment)
1. namespace <zone>-* must carry label platform/zone=<zone>
2. mutation per zone (namespace prefix): pod gets nodeSelector + toleration of the zone
3. deny pods selecting or tolerating any other zone

Platform DaemonSets
(Cilium, CSI, monitoring agent)
tolerate all zones

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stateless clusters: node auto provisioning (Karpenter)
NodePool + AKSNodeClass per zone (Flux): zone subnet, cell's AZ,
allow-list of VNet-encryption-capable SKUs, limits sized for N+1
nodes created for pending pods, consolidated when under-used

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stateful cluster: classic node pools per zone and AZ (IaC)
fixed VM size and node count – no autoscaling
nodes change only in planned upgrades
